name: Icy Will
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 7th; Slot none; Price 131,580 gp; Weight 3.5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Icy will is a +3 icy burst speed mithral elven curve blade. It can sense the alignment of its bearer and even perform minor shapeshifting. After possessing icy will for at least 24 hours, a good or lawful neutral bearer will find that the sword has taken on the form of their preferred melee weapon with mithral scales as accents.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Staff, Quicken Spell; Spells haste, modify memory, moment of prescience, slow; Cost 68,000 gp
